text:
Silver Price in 2001
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2001, the LBMA silver price fell 5.6% between 2001-01-31 ($4.79) and 2001-12-31 ($4.52). The highest sampled price was $4.79 in January and the lowest was $4.14 in November. The mean of these observations was $4.38. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
